conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND severity="ERROR" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^(deleteuseraccount|reportclienterror)$" AND NOT (resource.labels.service_name="reportclienterror" AND jsonPayload.event="FRONTEND_ERROR_REPORTED")

documentation.content: Exceção crítica ou falha inesperada nas Cloud Functions de backend (deleteUserAccount ou reportClientError). Consulte o runbook em docs/incident-response.md e investigue a causa raiz no Cloud Logging.
